scope_statement: Lifecycle-review evidence only. No production/test/config source is replaced or mutated by this skeleton.

boundaries.contract: ExactModelAccessGuard remains the sole READ/WRITE policy authority; operation/target/path/session proof must match exactly.
Guard-minted authority is one-shot and READ cannot satisfy WRITE.
No ordinary raw/proofless executable MODEL effect overload is available to the orchestration caller.
Call order is rule lookup -> target resolution -> exact Guard denial -> operation branch -> Guard authorization -> effect; all denial branches occur before effect.
Production factory captures one final EngineContext for the runtime generation.
One active runtime generation binds one Context; no hot reload/rebind; a new Context belongs to a new generation after old artifacts close.

resource_failure_boundaries.write_denial: zero effect invocation, therefore zero write side effects
resource_failure_boundaries.authorization: one-shot claim consumption is owned below this skeleton boundary
resource_failure_boundaries.runtime_close: old generation becomes CLOSED before a new generation may capture a new Context
resource_failure_boundaries.transaction_retry_compensation: not introduced by P2; MODEL effect transaction behavior remains owned by existing lower-level implementation and is not redesigned here

implementation_deferred: compiler publication and process bootstrap implementation
